title: Search that finds
description: Serves "Finding something to watch is easy.". D-148: Postgres first, with no search service until a measurement asks for one.
acceptanceCriteria: Search finds a title from its first letters, and by its original or another title taken from the file beside it.
Results come back within a stated time at one, two and three letters, measured on a collection of stated size (#228).
It finds people and collections as typed results.
When the collection does not have what was asked, it says so and offers titles it does have.
Only titles the viewer may see are found.
A title is still found when its name is misspelled: one wrong letter in a word of 5 to 8 letters and two in a longer word, measured on a synthetic title set.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
